name: Sign-in form
summary: Work email and password with show and hide, remember this device, and a single sign-on option, shown with a wrong-password error.
use: on a work app's sign-in page
a11y: Each input has a visible label; the error is tied to the password with aria-describedby and aria-invalid, and the show button is a toggle with aria-pressed.

use_when: a work tool where people sign in with a password or through their company's single sign-on
avoid_when: entering a one-time code sent by email or text: use code-input
creating a new account or inviting people: use invite-members for invites; this form only signs in
a consumer app that signs in with one tap only: this form leads with email and password

parts.name: title
parts.what: what the person is signing in to, the one heading

parts.name: hint
parts.what: a short line on which email to use

parts.name: email
parts.what: the work email field with its label

parts.name: forgot
parts.what: the link to reset the password, beside its label

parts.name: password
parts.what: the password field with its label

parts.name: error
parts.what: the message under the password when sign-in fails, after an icon

parts.name: remember
parts.what: remember this device, with how long

parts.name: sso
parts.what: the single sign-on option, under an 'or' divider

parts.name: foot
parts.what: a line for people without an account, with a link

empty.how: start with both fields blank; if Sign in is pressed with one empty, add the invalid style to that field and an error line under it

loading.how: the Smart UI renderer draws each marked slot as a quiet block of its size while the data arrives; the static file shows the filled part

error.how: a wrong password gives the field a red border and a message tied to it

disabled.how: after too many tries, set disabled on the password field and Sign in, and say when to try again in the error line

overflow.how: in a very narrow box the Show button drops its word and keeps the icon

long_text.how: a long email scrolls inside its field, and the error wraps beside its icon

keyboard: Tab reaches the email field, Forgot password, the password field, Show, Remember this device, Sign in, Continue with single sign-on, then the invite link
Enter or Space on Show switches the password between hidden and shown
Space ticks or unticks Remember this device
Enter in a field submits the form, but the file stops the submit and does nothing else
Continue with single sign-on is a button with no action wired in the file
